subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should OpenClaw backfill signed macOS desktop assets and `appcast-beta.xml` for `v2026.5.22-beta.1`, or explicitly leave that beta train without desktop assets under the current beta-channel docs?
rationale: The remaining work depends on private release credentials and a release-policy choice that automation cannot safely make from source alone.

options.title: Review the paired PR and publish the beta assets
options.body: Release owners would land or replace the signed-beta distribution path, run the private macOS publish workflow, and keep this issue open until the release assets and beta appcast are live.

options.title: Document no macOS desktop build for this beta
options.body: Release owners would record that this beta train intentionally remains CLI/npm-only and then close this issue with that release decision.

options.title: Split future policy from this old beta
options.body: Release owners would close or defer the old-beta backfill while tracking a narrower future policy for beta desktop gates.

recommendation.title: Review the paired PR and publish the beta assets
recommendation.body: Release owners would land or replace the signed-beta distribution path, run the private macOS publish workflow, and keep this issue open until the release assets and beta appcast are live.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available decision owner from the history because the issue crosses project release policy and the appcast surface he has repeatedly maintained.
